Agreement for deep sea sand
mining
*241. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the State Government of Kerala entered into
an agreement with a private firm for deep
sea sand mining;
(b) whether the Government of Kerala
sought the opinion of Central agencies on
the environmental impact before signing
agreement;
(c) whether Government subscribe to
the view that the dredging causes irreparable
damage to the Marine Eco System and
traditional fishing sector;
(d) whether Government propose to
conduct a study on the environmental impact
of sand mining through any Central
agencies; and
(e) the extent to which the Coastal Zone
Regulation  Act permits the mining of sea
sand?

CARIAPPA:

(a) number of districts in the country as
on date where arrangements have not been
made to send the children for primary
education;
(b) whether Government have
formulated any special scheme to send the
poor children and those suffering from
poverty and starvation to school;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
increase fees of college students of General
and Professional Courses;
(b) if so, by when it is likely to be
implemented; and

be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that cattle in our
country are victims of partial starvation and
extensive mal-nutrition;

(a) whether it is a fact that snakes are

register all Madaris in the country and to

Ultrasonic Flaw Detection Test for
tracks
*249. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:

of new trains is adversely effecting the rail

Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND

(a) the area under forest in Jammu and
Kashmir in 1950 and at present;
(b) whether the area under forest has
declined; and
(c) if so, the steps taken to increase the

the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) what are the State-wise details of

financial year?

Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:

grant-in-aid by the Central Government for
the protection of environment;

organisations indicating the year from which

works executed by them with the funds

Education Sector

Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to open
Elementary Education Sector to Foreign
Direct Investment;

(c) whether Government have set up any

Ozone depletion
*256. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether India is a signatory to
Copenhagen and Montreal protocols on
controlling Hydro-Chloro-Fluro Carbon
(HCFC), Hydro-Bromo-Fluro Carbon
(HBFC) and Methylene bromide emissions
causing damage to Ozone layer on its skies;
(b) if so, the measures initiated by India
to protect the Ozone layer; and

KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up sports centres in all the districts of
Rajasthan for the promotion of sports;
(b) if so, the details thereof including the
details of budget allocation; and

likely to be functional?

†*258. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of universities in North-
Eastern States for which University Grants

Year Plan, State-wise/year-wise/University-
wise;
(b) the names of universities in North-
Eastern Region which have utilised the
sanctioned grant and if not, the reasons
therefor; and
(c) the grants proposed to be provided
to each of the universities of all the said
States during Tenth Five Year Plan?
